title: Riot Squad Pod Liq Cherry Lime Blue Razz 80ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pod Liq Shortfills are the latest innovation from Riot Squad that let you enjoy the long-lasting value and great flavours of Shortfill E-liquids in a huge variety of vape kits that use higher-resistance coils. Pod Liq’s unique 60%PG/40%VG ratio is tailor-made for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping with its perfect balance of vapour, flavour and throat hit. Available in 120ml bottles with 80ml of 0mg E-liquid, you have the freedom to tailor your nicotine content with the use of Nicotine Shots . Two x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 100ml of 3mg 50/50 E-liquid. While Four x 10ml 18mg 70/30 Nicotine Shots added to an 80ml Shortfill bottle of Riot Squad Pod Liq E-liquid will create approximately 120ml of 6mg 50/50 E-liquid. Riot Squad's Cherry Lime Blue Raspberry 60/40 Shortfill E-liquid is a unique triad of flavours that elevates your vaping experience to electrifying heights. Imagine yourself sipping on a layered cocktail where each ingredient brings its own special flair—that's the essence of this e-liquid captured in every bottle. The journey kicks off with the rich, ripe sweetness of cherries, setting the stage with a familiar and inviting lusciousness. Just when you think you've grasped the profile, a rush of zesty lime cuts through, creating a multi-layered palate that oscillates between sweet and tangy. Finally, a twist of blue raspberry emerges, offering a tart and enigmatic finish that completes this complex flavour story. What sets Cherry Lime Blue Raspberry apart is its ability to maintain a fine balance between three strikingly different but complementary flavours. It's like a carefully composed musical triptych, each note contributing to a captivating overall experience. Whether you're new to the vaping scene or a seasoned connoisseur, this blend offers an exciting, flavourful journey that you'll want to revisit time and time again.
